title: London vs Amsterdam: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Amsterdam wins on charm, walkability, and cost. London wins on free museums, food diversity, and scale. Do both via Eurostar if you have 7+ days.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Amsterdam €90–140/day vs London £100–160/day — Amsterdam roughly 15–25% cheaper overall.

categories.name: Walkability
categories.summary: Amsterdam is extremely compact and bikeable. London requires the Tube for most inter-attraction journeys.

categories.name: Museums (Value)
categories.summary: London's major museums are free (British Museum, V&A, National Gallery, Tate Modern). Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum cost €22+ each.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: London's global diversity is unmatched. Amsterdam has unique Dutch and Indonesian food but a smaller overall scene.

categories.name: Iconic Sights
categories.summary: London has Tower Bridge, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace. Amsterdam has canals, Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank House, Van Gogh Museum.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Amsterdam for brown cafés and Paradiso/Melkweg clubs. London for West End theatre and 24-hour weekend Tube.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Amsterdam's April (King's Day + tulip season) is one of Europe's unmissable seasonal events.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Amsterdam: Keukenhof, Zaanse Schans, Delft, Bruges. London: Bath, Stonehenge, Oxford, Cambridge, Cotswolds.

faq.question: Is London or Amsterdam better for first-time visitors to Europe?
faq.answer: Both are excellent. London for English speakers wanting free museums and variety; Amsterdam for a more compact, charming canal city experience in 3 days. Do both if you have 7+ days.

faq.question: How far apart are London and Amsterdam?
faq.answer: About 500 km. Eurostar takes 3h55m from London St Pancras to Amsterdam Centraal. Budget flights take ~1h15m but airports are far from centers.

faq.question: Is Amsterdam cheaper than London?
faq.answer: Amsterdam is 15–25% cheaper — especially for accommodation. London's free museums offset some of the cost difference.

faq.question: How many days for Amsterdam vs London?
faq.answer: Amsterdam: 3 full days. London: minimum 4 days. Book Anne Frank House 2+ months in advance.
